notes.title: Mod Support and PC Compatability | The Deadseat
notes.content:
STEAM WORKSHOP & MODDING
Our game now has its own STEAM WORKSHOP! You can mod your game with a single click.

Thanks to the work of an amazing fan who goes by 'DumbBird', we've been able to make modding this game a breeze. If you're a player, just visit the Workshop and subscribe to any mod!

There's not many mods now, but thanks to DumbBird, more are on the way!

Customkyd (Change GameKyd color, OUT NOW!)

Multiplayer (Face off against your friend as the monster, COMING SOON!)

VR (Play the game from a new perspective, COMING SOON!)

HEY YOU THE GAME IS ON SALE FOR $1.97 TELL YOUR FRIENDS!!!

If you're a mod creator, you can find instructions for creating Deadseat mods on the workshop (which will slowly be updated to be even easier and easier.) Massive thanks to Godot Mod Launcher.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602392/c6510721121594cf7ccb718f5c04dfbea17d9687.png"]


PC COMPATABILITY
We received a good number of people who were unable to play the game due to their PC specifications. We've updated our game engine to allow greater support with Vulkan, which should be most of you, but for those who are still unable to open the game, we've added a new launch option for OpenGL. This will make the game look a little weird... But it should allow most people to play!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602392/bbab41e7058cec88d5b3572ebd4e2a179a11ecb1.png"]




OTHER ADDITIONS
Added option to randomize customization (along with a setting in randomized runs).

Added option to skip level intros in challenge mode.

Dying to red eyes will now display red eyes on the monster (‘default’ and ‘the skinned’).

Removed fullscreen_toggle using F.

Updated GODOT version v4.0.3 -> v4.4.1.

Fixed gamekyd toggle bar to be more accurate, both visually and functionally.

Fixed corruption tutorial playing when the player doesn’t even have corruption enabled.

Fixed monster flashing when steering for the first time.

Fixed tree clipping by changing the transparency to alpha_scissor instead of depth_pre_pass.

Fixed visual bug when sometimes steering the car.

Fixed GPS not being animated during sunset scene.

Wind sfx no longer plays right before sunset scene.

Fixed gamekyd sounds not playing during final hunt in hardmode.

Adjusted presets to be selected by matching its adjustments and challenges.

Fixed ‘Overcome’ achievement to check if either ‘suffer’ is selected OR the player is at max score,

Fixed not being able to steer too early when monster is approaching from the front

notes.title: Patch #3 - 6/15/25
notes.content:
Hope you've been enjoying challenge mode! We've got a few quick fixes.


 There's a new cosmetic reward for beating the SUFFER preset in Challenge mode.
 'The Skinned' in challenge mode has had its red eyes visually reworked.
 Fixed a bug where randomizing a challenge mode run would activate a removed challenge.
 Exiting email will put you back to challenge mode instead of the main menu.
 Player can no longer force their way into the gamekyd car.
 Slightly delayed pause when entering the 'sunset' scene.
 Fixed not being able to use the fullscreen toggle when paused.
 Fixed a few adjustment descriptions in challenge mode.
 Fixed being able to open / close gamekyd during the 'you win' screen.

That's all for now!

notes.title: New Challenge Mode | The Deadseat 2.0
notes.content:
NEW CHALLENGE MODE
After completing Hard Mode, you will unlock the brand-new challenge mode! This mode features:

10 Intense Challenges!

MANY cosmetic options, such as other player characters, a new enemy, many custom tile sets for the Gamekyd (with custom music) and more!

A whole bunch of new lore.

8 Presets for unique challenge combinations.

Sliders for full customization.

5 New Achievements!

A randomize option for a more exciting experience.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602392/b142c988e018a4375d3758bdf1fc5cc6f247fb1f.png"]

The 8 presets serve as a sort of level system. The max score is 10,000 and each preset will slowly take you there, introducing the new challenges AND providing new lore with each milestone. But there's no one way to play... customize, challenge yourself... and enjoy!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602392/8f1149c18c244fcb991825143e73266d735ce87b.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602392/183c3b0c388b95eda7f4137a1f57139b883f37e2.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602392/e3719c154aca374a6772cf0d2a0d47d31b5393b9.png"]

Aside from patches, this will likely be the only major content update to 'The Deadseat' for now. We are moving back onto our much larger game (which is in the same location as this one) 'Feed The Pit'! Please Wishlist it if you enjoyed 'The Deadseat'.


Other Additions:
Added fullscreen toggle with ‘F’.

Changes to Windshield texture.

Fixed console error related to 2d tilemaps.

Fixed bug where monster phases through car when drinking soda.

‘The 5th Sin’ achievement now is unlocked after eating the final chicken, instead of when the credits roll.

Fixed bug that would break level progression when leaving and resuming the game at certain points (I think).

Various smaller fixes.

notes.title: Patch #2 - 5/18/25
notes.content:
Custom Mode
We are currently working on a CUSTOM MODE! This mode will bring forth new cosmetic choices, like the option to have Kaleb scavenge through a beach. And it'll allow you to enable/disable many different values of your choice, as well as take on brand new challenges. At it's hardest, it'll make even Hardmode seem easy... What sorts of challenges would you like to see?

Patch Notes

New monster interaction for whenever a door is missing.
Added the option to use Spacebar to control the Gamekyd.
Tweaked layout of Level 2 in hardmode,
Fixed a few collision issues in Gamekyd levels,
Adjusted timing of some dialogue.
Disabled reflections on Deer/Rabbits at the end of hardmode.
Moved car down in 2D driving section.
Fixed trees clipping into camera when steering in hardmode.
Fixed a bug that would prevent the steering camera animation from playing.
A few other tweaks and adjustments.

More updates coming soon! Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Patch #1 - 5/15/25
notes.content:
Thank you all so much for the amazing response to the game's launch! Seeing everyone's reactions and feedback has been so touching, and we are really glad the story has resonated with so many people. Let us know what new features, fixes, and changes you'd like to see in the future of The Deadseat! And please share the game with friends- Every sale allows us to make more awesome stuff for you all.

Now- onto the first patch!

 In Hardmode, the Gamekyd obstacles will now have a reduced speed whenever the player is up front steering the car.
 You can no longer reenter the car in the level where you must [spoiler]"Get the stone."[/spoiler]
 The monster now has a limited number of times that in can attack the same direction in a row.
 Fixed a bug where multiple songs overlapped after [spoiler]smashing the gamekyd.[/spoiler]
 Fixed a UI bug when clicking on external buttons.

Expect another patch in the next day or two!
